newsitem.title: UK: GOLF-NILSSON NAMED NEW SOLHEIM CUP CAPTAIN.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-NILSSON NAMED NEW SOLHEIM CUP CAPTAIN.

text.p: Sweden's Pia Nilsson has been appointed captain of the European Solheim Cup golf team in succession to Mickey Walker.
Nilsson, 38, was vice-captain under Walker at St Pierre, Chepstow, in September when America's women, 9-7 behind entering the last day singles, stormed to a 17-11 win.
Walker had been captain since the inaugural match in 1990, leading Europe to victory at Dalmahoy two years later. But after two defeats since then she said: "I think four is enough."
Nilsson's first match in charge will be in 1998 at Muirfield Village, Ohio, scene of Europe's first Ryder Cup triumph on American soil nine years ago.
Currently head coach to the Swedish national teams programme, Nilsson is a former member of the European women's tour board of directors.
This year's European side contained four Swedes -- Annika Sorenstam, Lotta Neumann, Helen Alfredsson and Catrin Nilsmark.
Sweden hope to stage the Solheim Cup in 2000 and Nilsson is expected still to be captain then.
